{{Short description|Chinese mathematician (1937-)}}
'''Jiang Boju''' ({{zh|s=姜伯驹}}; born September 1937<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=姜伯驹----中国科学院学部 |url=http://casad.cas.cn/sourcedb_ad_cas/zw2/ysxx/sxwlxb/200906/t20090624_1792050.html |access-date=2022-07-28 |website=casad.cas.cn}}</ref>) is a Chinese mathematician and a professor of [[Peking University]], School of Mathematical Sciences. He is known for his contributions to topology.<ref>{{Cite book|title=数学辞海 • 第六卷|author=《数学辞海》编辑委员会编|publisher=中国科学技术出版社|year=2002|isbn=|location=北京|pages=}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|title=历届全国政协委员人名辞典|author=|publisher=中国国际广播出版社|year=1996|isbn=9787507813746|location=北京|pages=}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|title=数学史辞典|author=杜瑞芝主编; 王青建, 孙宏安副主编|publisher=山东教育出版社|year=2000|isbn=|location=济南|pages=}}</ref>

== Honors ==
He was elected to be a member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 1980<ref name=":0" /> and a fellow of [[TWAS]] in 1985.<ref>{{Cite book|title=中华当代文化名人大辞典|author=张品兴, 殷登祥, 陈有进等主编|publisher=中国广播电视出版社|year=1992|isbn=9787504315137|location=北京|pages=}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|title=二十世纪中国名人辞典|author=蔡开松, 于信凤主编; 曾卓明, 周溯源, 赵书刚副主编|publisher=辽宁人民出版社|year=1991|isbn=|location=沈阳|pages=}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Jiang Boju|url=https://twas.org/directory/jiang-boju|accessdate=2022-02-07|work=TWAS}}</ref>

== Family ==
Jiang Boju's father [[Jiang Lifu]] was a mathematician and educator widely regarded as the Father of modern Chinese mathematics.<ref>{{Cite web|title=姜立夫：他是数学家更是数学教育家|url=https://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2010/10/238443.shtm|accessdate=2022-02-07|work=科学网}}</ref>
